hooks.name: Security Audit After Task
hooks.description: Runs a security audit per the Security Auditor role after a spec task completes.

action.prompt: A task was just completed. Act as the Security Auditor (.github/agents/security-auditor.agent.md) and follow the project's Security Auditor record. Audit the changed files in scope. Append findings to docs/quality/security-findings.md with category, severity, file path, and line numbers. If there are no findings, state "No security findings for this task."
